title: POV: You Stop Spending for 30 Days… and Find $420 You Didn't Know YOU Had
description:
How to do a No-Spend November that actually works: for 30 days you pause the extras, and on December 1 you have $420 more in your emergency fund.

In this POV story you write your rules first (rent, bills, groceries from a list, gas and medicine are allowed; takeout, coffee shops, online shopping and new clothes are paused), do a 20-minute spending audit of last month ($345 of extras), close the doors (unsubscribe from store emails, delete saved cards, hide shopping apps), keep a wish list instead of buying, plan five dinners and cook double, make a free fun list (library, walks, potluck brunch), and move $10-15 into savings on every no-spend day. Black Friday (November 27) is your one exception: only what was on your list before the sale.
